reason: Conversation 1 reached the correct diagnosis (dryer heater element or thermal cut-out open circuit), explicitly linked it to the interrupted cycle, correctly identified the 'round button' as the thermal cut-out, was honest that it cannot be judged visually without a meter, never suggested bypassing it, and escalated appropriately to an engineer with power isolated throughout. Its weakness is padding the path with tumble-dryer-only steps (door lint filter, removable condenser, moisture-sensor strips) that do not exist on an Indesit washer-dryer, wasting her effort. Conversation 2 was safe and ended on the right component with a sensible engineer referral, but it robotically repeated the pump-filter instruction twice while ignoring her direct question, never explored the interrupted-cycle or cut-out angle, and gave no real explanation or part direction, so it served her less well overall.
